content: 1. Begin by using the WikiDoc slide template to prepare your slides. All slides on WikiDoc adhere to the same standardized template. You can download the template by clicking on the provided image. 2. Upload your slides to the WikiDoc server. Slides can only be inserted into a WikiDoc page if they have been uploaded to the server. If the slides you wish to use are not yet on the server, you must upload them. To access the upload page, either click on the provided link or search for Special:Upload on WikiDoc. This page contains detailed instructions for uploading images or files to the server. 3. On the upload page, you will encounter two fields. In the Source file name field, click the Browse button to locate the file on your computer that you wish to upload. In the Destination file name field, type the name you want the slide set to have on WikiDoc. Ensure the name is descriptive and relevant to the content of the slide set, as this will help with search engine indexing and retrieval. 4. After naming the file, click the Upload file button. Once the upload is complete, the slide set will appear on the server. It is recommended to copy the file name for later use when inserting it into a WikiDoc page. 5. Once the slide set is uploaded, it can be inserted into any number of pages on WikiDoc. You can find the file names of uploaded slides, images, videos, and other media in the File list section. Knowing the file name is essential for inserting the slide set into a page. 6. To place the slide set into a chapter, create a link to download the slide set. It is generally best to position the link above the relevant content in a way that is clear and accessible to viewers. To create the link, use an internal link to the file, similar to how you would link to another page on WikiDoc. An example of this process is provided for reference.
